name: @quarry/ontology-indexer-runtime
description: The Ontology's indexer runtime: a Nest microservice over stdio, run as the main process of a Forge job container (image quarry/ontology-indexer-runtime). Loads one object type's index: reads its backing dataset through signed URLs, writes into the index database through a scoped connection. See docs/design/ontology-indexer.md.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild dist/applications/ontology/indexer-runtime/src/main.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/runtime.js --external:@duckdb/node-api --external:@nestjs/websockets --external:@nestjs/platform-express --external:class-transformer --external:class-validator --external:@grpc/* --external:kafkajs --external:mqtt --external:nats --external:ioredis --external:amqplib --external:amqp-connection-manager
